steps.text: Bring a shovel and a rope (the way to Demona).
In Demona's main room, go down the north-easternmost stairs (an elf arcanist and warlocks).
steps.source: Follow the route to Demona and go up into the main (pentagrammatic) room. Make your way to the northeastern-most staircase while fending off an Elf Arcanist and some Warlocks and go down.

steps.text: Follow the long hallway to the big room (elf arcanists and warlocks) and go up the stairs.
steps.source: You will come to a long hallway you'll have to follow all the way until you get to a big room filled with Elf Arcanists and Warlocks. Go up either staircase in this room.

steps.text: The left chest in the south: the stealth ring.
steps.source: There are two chests in the south of this floor, with the left one containing a Stealth Ring and the right one an Energy Ring.

steps.text: The right chest: the energy ring.
steps.source: There are two chests in the south of this floor, with the left one containing a Stealth Ring and the right one an Energy Ring.
